scope: Interim frozen stage snapshot; not a complete gold build or a current v3 rebuild.

docling_expression_fidelity.meaning: Fidelity among aligned emitted selected source expressions, not repair precision.

docling_bounded_source_recall.meaning: All-source selected occurrence coverage includes four deliberately excluded input pages; conditional fraction explicitly removes them.

chunks_and_markdown_expression_fidelity.meaning: Footnote role in flattened text is indeterminate; report both bounds, not a selected favorable denominator.

admitted_scientific_repair_precision_in_.meaning: Two independently source-selected inverse-exponent operations, both in Mańko. Does not estimate proposal-wide or corpus-wide repair precision.

no_scientific_repair_expression_correctn.meaning: Correctness of expressions with no admitted scientific repair, not model routing accuracy; other build producers may have run.

expression_output_precision.reason: All candidate renderings/spurious variants across all output surfaces have not been independently enumerated. Source occurrence fidelity is not substituted for this metric.

actual_embedding_input_and_served_text.reason: Gold launch is CPU extract only; no actual embedding input or bounded served replay inspected in this comparison.

known_limitations: No ±/∓, µm, or subtraction equation selected.
One paper supplies all selected inverse exponents.
Interim sample availability depends on live build order, not a random completion sample.
No inference from artifact presence alone: completed pipeline_state stages captured and verified stable while reading.
Footnote role uncertainty is explicitly recorded in assessment-clarification.md.
